sentences.text: HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  Order Sheet

In Re : I.A. No. 1/2023  CRA No. 1618 of 2023   Rajesh Dhurve S/o Shri Kantilal Dhurve Aged About 25 Years  R/o Village Salhetola Police Station Davenewada, District  Gondiya, Maharashtra  ---- App  Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through District Magistrate, Mungeli  District Mungeli (C.G.)
 ---- Respon 10-11-2023

Appellant has preferred this criminal appeal being aggrieved by the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 18-7-2023 passed by learned Special Judge (FTSC)
POCSO Act, Mungeli in Special Criminal case No. 45/2022, whereby the appellant has been convicted under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced as under :-
Section Jail sentence Fine sentence Default stipulation 363, IPC 5 years, RI Rs.
1000/- 2 months SI 366, IPC 5 years, RI Rs. 1000/- 2 months SI 6, POCSO Act 20 years RI Rs. 1000/- 2 months SI Heard Mr. Vijay Shankar Mishra, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Vasim Miyan, learned Panel Lawyer, appearing for the State/respondent and Ms. Jyoti Rathore, learned counsel for the objector on the instant application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A. No. 1/2023)
preferred by appellant Rajesh Dhurve.
Learned counsel for the convict/appellant has argued that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix was not minor at the time of incident and the prosecution has failed to prove her age.
It is submitted that the appellant is in jail since 28-7-2022 and the appeal is likely to take a couple of years or even more in its final disposal.
Hence he prays that the sentence of appeal may be suspended.

However, Mr. Vasim Miyan, learned counsel appearing for the State duly assisted by Ms. Jyoti Rathore, learned counsel appearing for the objector opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and submits that the in this case the appellant has abducted and committed sexual intercourse with her on the pretext of marriage.
The prosecutrix in her statement has stated in para 3 that the appellant has made physical relation with her.
Hence, the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail may be rejected.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the court below.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, also considering the evidence available on record, further considering the statement of the prosecution who is minor and has stated that appellant has made physical relation with her and further that FSL report is positive, we deem it appropriate to reject the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant Rajesh Dhurve.
Accordingly, IA No. 1/2023 filed in both above appeals by appellant Rajesh dhurve stands rejected.
Let the matter be listed for final hearing after 8 weeks.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (N.K. Chandravanshi) (Ramesh Sinha)
